description: A probe, not a test of behaviour: what does the voice model itself hear, beyond the words? It is played a real laugh (from the user's session of 2026-11-13, runs/2026-11-13T16-20-06-gemini-app, which has to be kept) and asked what the sound was, then a second voice and asked whether it was a different person, a man or a woman. Run with --no-prompter, so that nothing but its own ears tells it, and ten times: at three runs a real difference looked like noise. Read what Stand said in the report. STAND_SWAP with the files in poc/heckler/hearing/ puts a plain listener's role in place of Stand's, to compare.

discussion.say: Stand, a moment ago, before I spoke, there was a sound in the room. What was it? Describe what you heard.
The meeting room on the third floor is free on Friday.
Stand, the sentence about the meeting room. Was it said by me, or by a different person? And did it sound like a man or a woman?
